title: The Onion:  Translator Of Original ‘Minions’ Epic Poem...
content: The Onion: Translator Of Original ‘Minions’ Epic Poem Slams ‘Sexless, Bloodless’ Film Adaptation. The actual Wilson on Bluesky: “No professional accomplishment has ever made me happier than this.” Most fun movie discourse since Barbenheimer.
author: Jason Kottke
